name: Fade
source:
Once there was a troubled little boy. A very pampered, yet troubled little boy. All the spoils of the earth were his to be had at the snap of a finger. Yet, there was something missing.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250329180646/https://renai.us/game/fade]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
从前，有一个烦恼缠身的小男孩。他备受宠爱，却依然深受困扰。只需打个响指，世间一切享受都能归他所有。然而，他仍觉得缺少了什么。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250329180646/https://renai.us/game/fade]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
